name: Z-Image (base)

lineage.how_derived: full-capacity undistilled model; Turbo is distilled from it

purpose: Undistilled base for creative generation, fine-tuning and downstream development; supports CFG and negative prompts.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the Z-Image GitHub repository LICENSE; HF repo has no LICENSE file. HF API createdAt 2026-01-23 (base weights came two months after Turbo).

pc-12gb.notes: BF16 about 12 GB; needs quant or offload

pc-16gb.notes: 28-50 steps with CFG: several times the time of Turbo

engine_support.notes: Tona has no image path; plan in research/52 is stable-diffusion.cpp as a separate backend (one model at a time). No seconds-per-image was measured on gfx1200 yet.

user_reports.summary: One HF user reports better likeness when the LoRA is trained on Z-Image base and used on Turbo; fine-tuning guides treat base as the training checkpoint.

tona_fit.reason: Quality and license are fine (Apache-2.0 verified), but it is the fine-tuning base: more steps with CFG than Turbo for the same use. Becomes an offer for users who train LoRAs; no speed or quality advantage for plain generation.

sources.note: license text, read through a summarizer

open_questions: stable-diffusion.cpp support for the base checkpoint
Seconds per image on any consumer GPU for the base model: not found in searches on 2026-11-19
